title: cynoglossum coeruleum subsp. johnstonii
intro: Cynoglossum coeruleum subsp. johnstonii, commonly known as the Ethiopian forget-me-not, is a species of flowering plant in the borage family (Boraginaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe and protect the body from oxidative stress and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Cynoglossum coeruleum subsp. johnstonii are thought to be due to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. However, more research is needed to fully understand the potential health benefits and therapeutic actions of this plant, including its effects on specific health conditions.
